primary_text_personally_read.didymograptus: Maletz et al2018 morphology and Didymograptidae/Didymograptus diagnosis, pp17–20 and caption Fig16. 1984 abstract only, no false full-paper claim. Original inventory Atlas page read; its D.artus and M.clintonensis are NOT chosen species.
primary_text_personally_read.monograptus: Treatise account full relevant diagnosis and Fig300 caption. Maletz2020 section on mineral infill/compaction and Fig5 caption: relief specimens pyrite-filled or silica-coated, not preserved living color.
primary_text_personally_read.diplograptus: Mitchell/Maletz/Goldman2009 pp27–31, full morphology, proximal astogeny, Table1 and Fig1/2 captions. Strong apparent proximal genicula partly taphonomic; relative straightness in isolated specimen noted.
primary_text_personally_read.dictyonema: Maletz2019 original systematic text through type-material diagnosis, description, measurements, preservation, distribution and thecal-bridge definition read in Wiley web result. Direct local HTML403. Treatise online account itself has obsolete Callograptidae heading, superseded here by2019 Acanthograptidae revision.

didymograptus: didymograptus-fig16.png: Fig16.1a is lectotype BGS GSM6820b scientific drawing, not photo; pendent near-parallel gently widening stipes; inward thecal sawteeth; narrow central gap. Other species panels not transferred.

didymograptus-PRI111607.jpg: actual museum specimen photograph, Dyfed Wales Ordovician, 1cm scale; several fossils with paired pendent stipes and inward-facing sawtooth cups. Used for fossil gross form, not museum identification as a replacement for type-centered diagnosis.
monograptus: monograptus-fig5.png:2020 Fig5A/B SMF75780 relief photograph and coated detail; overlapping long tubes curve back at exposed tips;5G SMFXXIV401 secondary corroboration.
monograptus-fig300.jpg: only panels5a/b are Monograptus.5b actual SMF75780 relief,1mm scale;5a historical holotype drawing unscaled, type unlocated. No coiled Oktavites transferred.
diplograptus: diplograptus-fig1.png:2009 Fig1E Paasvere MS504a46.0m isolated infrared specimen has blunt proximal base, paired stout first-theca spines, open tubular alternating rows and free axial nema; A/B holotype and C/D/F/G compression/cast differences distinguished.
dictyonema: dictyonema-current.jpg: official expert page reprints original type drawings4a/4b;4c different species excluded.

dretiforme5specimens.jpg: mirrored Maletz2019 Fig2 original fossil photographs A AMNH-FI30943,B NYSMI7112,C AMNH-FI30945 holotype. Labels/scale caption crosschecked against original Wiley caption. Dense radiating cone-mesh preserved flattened with missing central attachment.

dretiforme6details.jpg: mirror of Maletz2019 Fig3A–C holotype details, irregular compound rope-like tubular stipes and oblique bridges. Only A–C obtained, not claim to have seen D–F.
